metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the street opened, the friend dead on the page, eight lines struck, the memo, Two Gentlemen, and one-and-thirty shillings.

yesterday: The friend dies under his own boy's arm. It is hardly a wound. The eight extra lines are struck. The curse in this setting-down is the short one.
Phillips has the best part in it, and he is dead by three o'clock on the page.
The share today is one-and-thirty shillings. The coffer stands where it was ruled, at twenty pound fifteen shillings.
Tomorrow is Sunday. The letter is still sealed, for the eleventh.
